name: Adobe Service Account (JWT) organization, technical account and API key identifiers
description: The three identifiers a Service Account (JWT) integration places in its JWT payload: the Organization ID (iss, format org_ident@AdobeOrg), the Technical Account ID (sub, format id@techacct.adobe.com) and the API key, also called the Client ID (aud, https://ims-na1.adobelogin.com/c/api_key), as the archived JWT page describes them. They identify the organization, account and application and are claims in the payload, not the private key that signs it. The pages read do not call them public or secret, so only their role is established; no sample is recorded.

sources.supports: iss: your Organization ID in the format org_ident@AdobeOrg. sub: your Technical Account ID in the format id@techacct.adobe.com. aud: your API Key in the format https://ims-na1.adobelogin.com/c/api_key.
